name: @reim-developer/magical-js
description: JavaScript and TypeScript bindings for magical_rs, a zero-dependency file type detection library.

scripts.pack:check: node -e "const{existsSync,statSync}=require('fs');const f='magical_js.wasm';if(!existsSync(f)){console.error('prepack: '+f+' is not built. Run npm run build first. Publishing without it ships a package that installs cleanly and then throws on its first call.');process.exit(1)}const n=statSync(f).size;if(n<1024){console.error('prepack: '+f+' is '+n+' bytes, which is not a WebAssembly module.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:only
scripts.gates: npm run gen && npm run build && npm run types && npm run test:only
